primary_evidence_order: prospectively frozen Signy Adelie external replication
prospectively frozen Signy chinstrap cross-species replication
novelty_statement: The analysis tests directional redistribution among breeding components after using the observed annual totals to define the latent abundance trajectory, beyond the mechanical abundance-occupancy coupling expected under fixed relative composition.
general_principle: Abundance decline constrains but does not determine the spatial trajectory of a structured population.

state_decomposition.p_t: relative spatial composition among monitored components
state_decomposition.proportional_thinning_null: latent N(t) set by observed annual totals; p(t) fixed; observed counts simulated with frozen error
state_decomposition.supported_departure: directional change in p(t) beyond finite-count and frozen observation-error effects

freeze_rules: No new ecological endpoint may be added before initial submission.
No new concentration metric, threshold, time window, error model or rescue analysis may be added.
Literature framing may distinguish the result from established abundance-occupancy relationships but may not claim priority without direct evidence.
N_eff must not be described as genetic Ne or genetic Nb.
Palmer colony codes remain monitored census units unless provider documentation establishes stronger continuity.
